title: AO/222/2009 of GUMAN DAS Vs SUNDER and OTHERS

paras.text:
Money Withdrawal Appln. No.601/2014
In
AO No.222/09
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Having heard Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for the
applicant/appellant, it transpires that five appeals were
filed by him bearing Nos.85/09, 86/09, 220/09, 221/09
and 222/09. In each appeal, he deposited a sum of
Rs.25,000/- as the statutory amount. All those appeals
were allowed vide judgment dated 25.6.2013 passed by this
Court.
 In the above circumstances, the applicant Guman
Dass is permitted to withdraw the statutory amount, so
deposited by him, as a condition precedent for preferring
such appeals.
 Money withdrawal application is, accordingly,
disposed of.
